dax_j_king: The draft reached R-F2 on Day 4. Dietrich "Tin" King was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Rain all night. Dietrich "Tin" King bailed water out of R-F2 with a helmet until his hands stopped feeling anything.
Dietrich "Tin" King took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure.
oreo_boi_5000: Ivo Boi signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F3 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Ivo Boi ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
Quentin Souptime (Hegemony) and Ivo Boi (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Drowned Farm. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
some_random_helldiver: Day 4: Rafael Helldiver reached R-F1 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Rafael Helldiver watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been. A letter from home found Rafael Helldiver before the night shift. Rafael Helldiver folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet found Rafael Helldiver at R-F1, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. A letter from home found Rafael Helldiver before the night shift. Rafael Helldiver folded it small and kept it close.
yaboypolarbear: Teodor Yaboypolarbe came from Rosenau, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Number 89 on the early rolls: Teodor Yaboypolarbe. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.
Teodor Yaboypolarbe got a letter from Ilse. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

Teodor Yaboypolarbe wrote back to Ilse and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Teodor Yaboypolarbe let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. Orders assigned Teodor Yaboypolarbe to work as a rifleman. The first lesson began with what not to touch. Teodor Yaboypolarbe became a signaller today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
A parcel from home held a comb. Teodor Yaboypolarbe has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at the Hanging Bridge. Teodor Yaboypolarbe fired. Gideon Bao pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'

Teodor Yaboypolarbe spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. A letter from home found Teodor Yaboypolarbe before the night shift. Teodor Yaboypolarbe folded it small and kept it close.
